In Magical Adventure - Fray CD - Xak Gai.summary: Fray in Magical Adventure CD: Xak Gaiden is an action role-playing game released for the PC Engine CD in 1994. It is a spin-off of the *Xak* series, starring the character Fray in a separate storyline. The game features overhead exploration, real-time combat, and animated cutscenes.
